title: Features
items:
[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*] Highlights nearby lootable containers while the configured highlight key is held.
[*] Screen-space markers can show a configurable icon, short text label, and marker color.
[*] Marker labels use a contrasting outline so the text stays readable over bright or noisy backgrounds.
[*] Optional world tinting can color compatible container render paths when Kenshi exposes a tintable target.
[*] Configurable scan distance for nearby container detection.
[*] Modifier-only highlight key support for Shift, Alt, or Ctrl based activation.
[*] In-game settings through Emkejs Mod Core / Mod Hub when installed.
[*] Advanced debug actions for probe snapshots and render tracing during troubleshooting.
[/list]
